messages:
maria: Heads-up: Crissy Field got hit by a surprise high tide and the Embarcadero is spraying. Took a detour — Caltrain still ok but BART is reporting "reduced service" on the Richmond line. Anyone else? :umbrella:
sam: Yep saw that. BART mobile says "Delays due to debris on tracks near 16th St." 😬 Leaving 10 min early now.
kelly: Thanks for the ping — I bike across the GG bridge path and it was super sloshy by the north lookout. Parked shoes: ruined.
jon: @sam which BART status page? throwing up hands rn
transit-bot: Service update: Richmond–Daly City: reduced service. Estimated clearance 20–30 min. https://bart.gov/alerts
amanda: I switched to MUNI N Judah, but it's packed. Heads-up for anyone near Embarcadero ferry — lines are long.
maria: Sam — here's the link I glanced at: https://m.bart.gov/s/alerts (copied from the app)
sam: thx. pinging team: @operations if anyone needs remote desk swaps later, I can cover the 11am standup.
kelly: Also 2 ducks went through my office window yesterday. unrelated but comedic relief.
maria: lol ducks = morale booster. ok folks take care, dry socks recommended :socks: (and a towel in your bag)
